paper.title_en: Rapidity-Spectral Decomposition and Spin Dynamics in Coupled Lorentz Spacetime Coordinates
paper.abstract_en: A novel framework for parameterizing Lorentz spacetime coordinates using coupled rapidity parameters is presented, extending classical special relativity with new insights into rapidity symmetries and spin effects. Building upon the Euler–Hamilton formalism, angular and transverse rapidities are introduced, enabling spectral decompositions of relativistic dynamics into elementary functions. The relativistic dynamics is expanded into rapidity spectra, yielding a new class of Lorentz coordinates with explicit rapidity dependence. These coordinates are applied to charged particle dynamics in the fields of plane monochromatic waves and pulsed laser beams. Spin degrees of freedom are incorporated by coupling spin-precession equations with rapidity variables, yielding new spin evolution equations in 3+1 dimensions. The structure of the proper Lorentz group SO(1,3) with coupled parameters is explored, and transformations in classical, rapidity-based, and Fermi coordinates are compared. As a special case, the formalism is applied to 1+1 dimensional relativistic hydrodynamics with spin.
